title: DevWorldGen
description: High-performance vanilla-style ore generation plugin for Paper servers. (Free Version)
body:
**This is a Free version of the plugin the ore generation will limitd to only 3 ores, Please consider buying the Full version [here](https://builtbybit.com/resources/devwoldgen.97049/)**

# DevWorldGen
**DevWorldGen** is a blazing-fast, fully customizable ore generation plugin that uses (almost) same ore generation algorithm as Vanilla Minecraft's ore placement, while remaining fully customizable.

**! This plugin is currently in development. Some features may break, but most functionality is already working.**

# Main Features
## Vanilla-Like Generation
The plugin uses an optimized version of Minecraft's vanilla ore generation algorithm for best performance and precision of generated ore.

## Minimal TPS Impact
This plugin is designed with speed in mind. With latest Paper API, The plugin only affects chunk generation performance, with minimal impact on gameplay TPS.

## Highly Configurable
You can config each ore generation to be UNIFORM (same generation rate over Y coordinates) or TRIANGLE (Ores most dense on the middle and less dense on top and bottom) and even filter by world types and biome.

## ItemsAdder support
ItemsAdder's custom block can be added to the config to generate ItemsAdder block into your world.

## Datapack Compatible
The plugin works with datapack-based world generation such as Terralith, Incendium, Nullscape, and similar datapacks or world-generation plugins.

## Chunky Compatible
The plugin's generation speed is fast enough to run with chunky plugin without any problems.

**! This plugin requires Paper (or a Paper fork) and Java 21+. Spigot is not supported.**
